lines.text: After Jesus finishes praying, a disciple asks Him to teach them to pray, just as John taught his disciples.
Jesus tells them to pray to God as King, ask for bread each day, and forgive everyone who sins against them.
In Jesus' story, a man asks his friend at midnight for three loaves, but the friend says his door is shut.
Jesus says the friend gets up because of the man's fear, and tells them to ask, seek and knock.
Jesus says evil fathers give good gifts to their children, and the Father in heaven will give the Holy Spirit.
